name: England survives France rally to claim third place in 10-goal thriller
snippet:
Bukayo Saka scored a hat trick, Ezri Konsa and Declan Rice struck early, and Jude Bellingham sealed it with the final goal in stoppage time.
A 4-0 halftime lead for England was nearly erased by France, before the Three Lions came back to win 6-4 behind a Bukayo Saka hat trick.
